title: [Bug]: Grep: offset/head_limit pagination silently drops and duplicates matches because ripgrep output order is non-deterministic across invocations
body:
<!-- oss-claim -->
Reproduced this. Root cause: src/agentscope/tool/_builtin/_grep.py:289 builds the rg argv with no sort flag, so rg's parallel walker returns matches in a different order on every in…
